§8[[Next entry]]§0

The castle holds tales of a lamp that burns away thorns. Perhaps its cinders could clear this rain,
twilightforest.book.trollcave.3: but the lamp is guarded atop the castle. To call the guardian out, I must gather the rune shards from all four parts of the castle and perform a ritual on the central platform of the roof.
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.3:
curse. The walls of this labyrinth are unnaturally hard; an ordinary pickaxe barely scratches them.

§8[[Next entry]]§0

Perhaps I need a bigger tool.
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.4: Giants are said to live above the clouds of the highlands, wielding pickaxes taller than a man. If one of those pickaxes could be reforged,
twilightforest.book.labyrinth.5: it might break through this maze. They say the troll caves hold a path up to the clouds...
twilightforest.book.lichtower.3:
§8[[Many entries later]]§0

A breakthrough! The curse is fed by a tower at the heart of the dark forest. I saw a huge ghast circling its top, and its cries carry the same magic.
twilightforest.book.lichtower.4: As long as that ghast lives, the barrier around this tower will hold. I must deal with it first.
twilightforest.book.tfstronghold.4: Slaying the great serpent in the forest courtyard should weaken the curse on the dark forest, and placing a trophy of a powerful creature on the pedestal would likely grant access into the main part of the stronghold.
